$comment: Hardware-accelerated CI targets. Setting the repository variable named by
skip_var to 'true' disables every job or step that executes on that device;
builds that only target it (images, wheels) still run. Resolved by
runs_on always names a runner group with one runner per physical device:
the runner serialises jobs, so the NVIDIA/AMD jobs need no concurrency groups.
gpu_test_smcp: gpu.yml also tests the target's SMCP preset (shares the GPU).

sm70.device: Tesla V100S 32 GB (xerxes GPU 0, shared with live/dev fuzzybits-server)

sm75.device: GTX 1660 Super (fzb-xerxes-4, gpu-runners group: not reachable from this public repository)

sm120.device: RTX 5060 Ti 8 GB (shelly GPU 0, shared with resident services)

metal-arm.device: Apple Silicon paravirtual Metal GPU (GitHub-hosted macos-26)

metal-intel.device: Intel Mac GPU (GitHub-hosted macos-15-intel; the Intel wheels are OpenMP-only today)
